summary_1line: Lakshmana obeys Rama’s order to abandon Sita by the Ganges, where she laments her fate and asks him to convey her final words to Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita collapses weeping on the sandy bank of the Ganges while Lakshmana stands nearby, torn with grief under the forest sky.
Sita, tearful and disheveled, raises folded hands toward Lakshmana as the wide sacred Ganges flows beside them.
Lakshmana stands silently with bowed head as Sita, abandoned in the wilderness, speaks her sorrowful message for Rama.
